analysis.analysis: R-1: Testable behavior includes verifying initial DOM elements (h1, h2, div, radio buttons, button) with exact text and data-testids. Boundaries: initial load state. Normal path: elements render correctly. Abnormal path: missing elements or incorrect attributes. R-2: Testable behavior includes question text updating across clicks on 'next-button'. Boundaries: exactly 3 questions ('What is the capital of France?', 'What is 2 + 2?', 'What is the largest ocean on Earth?'). Normal path: sequential updates. Abnormal path: out-of-order or missing updates. R-3: Testable behavior involves dynamic generation of radio buttons using quizData. Boundaries: array bounds of quizData. Normal path: correct options rendered with shared name 'option' and correct values/labels. Abnormal path: incorrect mapping or missing attributes. R-4: Testable behavior includes single-selection logic using radio buttons with data-testid 'option-{index}'. Boundaries: no selection by default. Normal path: selecting one option deselects others. Abnormal path: multiple selections allowed or no selection registered. R-5: Testable behavior includes score incrementing on correct answers and handling unselected options. Boundaries: max score equals total questions. Normal path: correct selection increments score by 1, unselected proceeds without increment. Ambiguity: R-5 says 'if correct, it increments the score by 1; if not selected, it proceeds without scoring', but doesn't explicitly detail incorrect selections (though implied as non-incrementing). R-6: Testable behavior includes hiding question, options, and next-button, and showing final score in data-testid 'score'. Boundaries: end of quiz. Normal path: elements receive 'hidden' class, score displays 'You scored X out of Y'.
